d: In this episode of Tarikh, we explore the terrifying rise and fall of Dadua (Shiv Kumar Patel), one of India's most feared dacoits. From avenging his father's murder at the age of 17 to building a ruthless empire across Bundelkhand and Chambal, this is the story of a man accused in over 400 criminal cases, including more than 200 murders. Discover how Operation Dadua, led by the Uttar Pradesh STF, ended his three-decade reign of terror in 2007, the deadly attack by the Thokiya Gang, and how technology brought the era of India's most notorious bandits to an end.
